Stubs are dead and dacayed. Very little decay in bole, solid trunk and bole. Excellent strong vigorous regrowth. Excellent tree
Extensive bole decay, bole centre mostly decayed away. Tree on bankside , has slipped partly into the brook quite a will ago. Regrowth strong vigorous excellent large diameter. Heavy shade
extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Trunk/bole are virtually dead except 2 thin strips of outer live wood on 2 sides 7 and 14inches wide. Regrowth 3 poles large diameter strong vigorous.
60% of bole/trunk/roots decayed and fallen away on SW side. Regrowth strong vigorous becoming large diameter. Heavily shaded, bankside exposed roots
Trunk and bole are solid but in very poor condition, large % of bole dead, large areas of bark necrosis on trunk on southside. Regrowth thin sparse, heavily shaded. 60% of buttress roots dead.

Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Centre of the tree has totally decayed away. Tree is in now split in 2. Heavy natural lean. Regrowth around ouer edge of bole likely to structurally fail if allowed to grow taller due to the extent of the decay. Heavy sha
Strip of dead decaying wood running from the top to bottom of trunk. Unclear as to whether this is a pollard as unable to establish bole. Regrowth suppressed by shade.

60-70% of tree has decayed away. Tree is in 2 separate sections. One section is just basal growth from stump, second is a strip of live outer wood 20inches wide with lots of regrowth Regrowth shade suppressed
Virtually the whole tree has decayed away except for a thin strip of outer live wood 7inches wide with a large diam pole. Heavy shade
60-70% of bole/trunk dead decaying. Tree has fallen due to decay but is still growing. Regrowth stunted
Significant bole/trunk decay, poss due to cutting?. Regrowth strong vigorous large diameter.
Extensive bole/trunk decay due to large cuts made. Regrowth strong vigorous large diameter but now in decline poor twig formation, retrenchment, reduction of laterals
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. 85% of tree decayed away. Tree is now just a thin strip of outer live wood on northside. Regrowth poor.

Extensive bole/trunk decay on southside. Heavily overshaded by large Hornbeam. Regrowth poor sparse prob due to shading, lower growth dying due to shade. Pollarding of neighbouring Hornbeam should increase response and vitality
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Tree decaying down the centre of the trunk. Excellent strong vigorous large diameter regrowt
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay, decaying down centre of trunk. Regrowth from around outside of bole one sided. Regrowth strong but suppressed by heavy shade.
Trunk and bole are completely dead decaying except for a thin strip of outer live wood 9inch wide on the southside. 3 regrowth poles. Heavy shading from northside.

Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Decaying through centre of trunk which will eventually split tree into 3 strips of outer live wood 14,6 and 6inches. Regrowth from the outside of a virtually dead bole.
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Centre of bole dead decaying, decay running down northside of trunk and centre. Regrowth mainly around edge of bole, strong vigorous. Bankside tree exposed roots.
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. 60% of tree has decayed away. Regrowth strong vigorous one sided
Solid trunk small amount of decay in bole. Dead dysfunctional wood/bark running down southside of bole. Regrowth large diameter suppressed by heavy shade. Exposed roots bankside
6 Ganoderma brackets on trunk. Significant bole decay. Dysfuntional strip of bark/wood running down trunk southside. Exposed roots bankside. Regrowth shade suppressed

Extensive bole/trunk decay. Total decay of centre and bole of tree splitting tree into 3 separate strips of live outer wood 23, 9 and 13inches. Regrowth strong vigorous and if allowed to grow larger will result in the failure of these strips. Arial roots
Small amount of decay in bole and trunk. Significant decay within centre of bole and trunk, unable to see clearly. Regrowth strong good considering heavy shading. Outer live wood solid intact.
70% of trunk/bole decayed away on NW side. Regrowth 3 poles strong becoming large diameter. Heavy shade

The whole tree is dead except for a thin strip of outer live wood 8inches wide on the northside. Regrowth is sparse suppressed by heavy shade. Tree had produced regrowth on the eastside for a num,ber of years before dying.

50-60% of tree has decayed away. Regrowth strong tall considering extreme heavy shading, lower growth retrenching due to shade, large areas of bud porliferation on trunk shade suppressing stimulation of growth
80-90% of tree has decayed away, only a thin strip of live outer wood remaining with 2 regrowth poles. Regrowth strong tall considering the extreme heavy shading
Virtually the whole tree is dead decaying except for a thin strip of outer live wood 6inches wide. Regrowth poor heavily shaded
Significant area of death to bole with small areas of decay. Decay through centre of trunk. Regrowth good, suppressed by heavy shade, large basal regrowth. Rideside.
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Centre of tree decayed away. Very poor regrowth, heavy shading
Centre of bole has virtually decayed away. Trunk solid. Regrowth poor suppressed by shade, lower growth dead dying
Significant decay in bole and down trunk on northside. Decay probably running through centre of trunk. Regrowth strong vigorous dense with basal epicormics
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay 60-70% decayed away on NE side. Tree is mainly just an outer shell on the southside only. Good regrowth
Extensive bole/trunk/root decay down centre of tree. Tree is now just 2 live strips of bark 13inch and 31inch strip. Honey fungus.
Extensive bole/trunk/ root/decay 70-80% of tree dead decaying. 19inch of live wood remaining eastside. Exposed roots on bankside, leaning tree, Thin diameter poles.
Significant bole decay. Solid trunk with no decay or dysfunction. Bole decaying but still fairly solid. Pole regrowth from around circumference of bole. Regrowth strong vigorous large diameter
Extensive bole decay. Significant trunk decay. 80% of bole dead decaying. Regrowth one sided due to heavy shade from Oak.
Extensive bole/trunk/root spiral decay. 85% of tree decayed. Regrowth poor stunted

Extensive bole/trunk/root decay. Decay down centre and southside of tree. 3 main regrowths tall heavy likely to fail. Only outer shell on northside alive. Regrowth strong but sparse due to heavy overshading
